It's an electrostatic compound with photoreactive properties.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]], during the Clone Wars|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] featured a region of '''badlands''' among its surface terrain. This region included the [[Crumbling Lands]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], elements of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] harvested an electrostatic soil compound with photoreactive properties to use as a strategic weapon against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
